segment.description: Dumplin Creek — a Douglas Lake tributary draining portions of Jefferson and Sevier counties (catalog; HUC 06010107 Lower French Broad, GNIS 01283130), entering the reservoir headwaters area near the Jefferson/Sevier county line. The catalog entry carries no trout program (stockingProgram: false).
segment.boundaries: No formal agency reach boundaries documented; the creek runs from the Jefferson County uplands down to the Douglas Lake headwaters. USGS station 03470215 'DUMPLIN CREEK AT MT. HAREB, TN' (36.0831, -83.4307, Jefferson Co., HUC 06010107, 4.23 sq mi drainage, station altitude 1,200 ft) documents the upper-creek reach.

coldSource.notes: No cold-water source documented; no dam on the creek and no spring-fed characterization found in any checked source. Elevation basis: USGS station altitude (1,200 ft NGVD29) at the Mt. Hareb headwater station — not a documented source-water attribution. The creek terminates in Douglas Lake, a TVA warmwater reservoir documented separately in this batch.

holdover.detail: No trout stocking has ever been documented on the creek — TWRA's 2026 schedule (live feed, 616 rows, re-verified 2026-09-18) contains zero 'Dumplin' rows — so there is no stocked-trout population to hold over. No angler or agency holdover record exists either.

wildPopulation.detail: Not on TWRA's Wild Trout Streams list (trout regulations page checked 2026-09-18 — no Dumplin entry); no wild trout record found in any checked agency source.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: No trout presence of any kind is documented — zero TWRA stocking rows, no wild-trout listing, no trout species record — and the creek's only water-temperature readings on file are non-summer (9.0 C in Dec 2004 at USGS 03470215; 16.4 C in Nov 2015 at the TDEC station), so summer suitability cannot be evaluated from evidence.
